handwriting_candidates.text_as_seen: Birthday Greetings to Degenerate One From Eaton Square to Burton Way from St. Moritz to Palm Beach & Menlo Hts — is it a mere 2 decades in Earth time (so many girls, so little time)? And you True Jeffrey always grinning like the MYSTERIOUS mischievous lad you are - I remember it all with a smile, though with a melancholy smile to think you were only at mid century a mere boy, (though we vampires are supposed to age slowly) (if at all). So There will be decades more of my screaming commodity writers or planes while the other passengers say SHH!, and you never failing to astonish me. I’ll look out the window and you’ll be shooting past on a rocket with a classic cut grin. Keep it up Jeffing, With great affection Degenerate II - AKA [redacted]
